# GitHub Copilot instructions

Use [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical repository operating contract.

Before modifying code, also read [`README.md`](../README.md) and [`docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`](../docs/PROJECT_STATE.md). For architecture, deployment, security, reasoning, or database work, follow the linked canonical documentation.

Do not invent or maintain conflicting Copilot-only rules. Update `AGENTS.md` when repository-wide operating policy changes.
